metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Sure, take this one for the memes’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get that by accident?
Enemy looked away and I got handed a gift.
Click if your aim’s more ‘oops’ than ‘pro’!

Try not to laugh at my accidental clutch!

Click if your kills come with zero effort but max chaos!
